The '''first Riileb''' was a mythical figure believed in by members of the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Riileb (species)|Riileb]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Riileb/Legends|same name]]. Supposedly the first member of the species to exist after their evolution from a [[Riileb precursor species|insect species]], the individual was rumored to have been the creator a the item of jewellery known as the [[ClanRing]], the holder of which ruled Riileb society. The Ring would traditionally be held by the eldest [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of a group known as the [[MotherClan]] who claimed to be direct descendants of the first Riileb.<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first Riileb was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement magazine series ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. It was in an article titled "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" written by [[Brian Smithson]]. A reduced version of the article was published in ''[[Alien Encounters]]'' which was a collection of all "Alien Encounters" articles compiled by [[Paul Sudlow]] in [[1998]].
